summary: Frontend-only validation of new 'Cadastrar visitante/fixo' shortcuts from unknown-face live events. Seeded db.access_events TEST_evt_unknown (person_id=null, stranger=true, captured_photo=real base64 jpeg). Logged in as admin and validated 4 scenarios end-to-end: (1) /cadastro/visitantes LiveAccessFeed shows the TEST row with type badge 'sistema', data-testid live-event-capture-TEST_evt_unknown-to-visitantes and ...-to-fixos both present and clickable. (2) Clicking 'Cadastrar visitante' navigated to /cadastro/visitantes?capture=<ts>, VisitForm cleared and loaded captured photo (data:image/* visible in Foto block, toast 'Foto capturada pelo facial carregada' shown). (3) Clicking 'Cadastrar fixo' navigated to /cadastro/fixos?capture=<ts>, PersonForm opened in kind=new with captured photo visible. (4) /monitoramento inspector for the TEST event shows inspector-no-registered ('Não identificado pelo facial'), inspector-capture-to-visitantes and inspector-capture-to-fixos, and NO inspector-edit-record; clicking inspector-capture-to-visitantes navigates to /cadastro/visitantes?capture=<ts> with photo. (5) Regression: clicking a person event (person_id present) still shows inspector-edit-record and no capture buttons. TEST data cleaned up at end.
critical_code_review_comments: CaptureActions encapsulates both target buttons with stable testPrefix (live-event-capture-<id> and inspector-capture) and stops click propagation to avoid triggering the row onClick in LiveAccessFeed — correct.
useUseCapture persists photo in sessionStorage['pi_capture_photo'] before navigating with ?capture=<ts>; VisitForm and PersonForm consume it via readCapture() on captureParam change — correct.
LiveAccessFeed.EventRow renders CaptureActions only when !canOpen (sistema branch) — matches requirement to show buttons only on unknown events.
LiveMonitoring inspector renders CaptureActions only when !selected.person_id — matches requirement; events with person_id continue showing inspector-edit-record.

Minor: VisitForm toast uses toast.info with text 'Foto capturada pelo facial carregada — preencha a visita' and PersonForm uses '…preencha o cadastro'. Requirement expected exact 'Foto capturada pelo facial carregada'; text contains the required prefix so acceptable.
seed_data_creation: Inserido db.access_events TEST_evt_unknown com captured_photo real (randomuser.me women/44); REMOVIDO ao final do teste.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fluxo 'Cadastrar visitante/fixo a partir de evento desconhecido' funcionando em LiveAccessFeed (/cadastro/visitantes) e em LiveMonitoring (/monitoramento). Para reproduzir manualmente sem simulador, insira um access_event com person_id=null e stranger=true via Mongo e abra as duas páginas. Branch 'sistema' em LiveAccessFeed (person_type vazio && !person_id) é a única maneira de ver os botões no feed lateral.
